title: Document Refresh
limitWarning: Your current license does not allow a frequency higher than {{hours}} hours ({{seconds}} seconds)
maxItemsSwitch: Set max number of documents to process in a single run

about.scanItem: The server scans the database at the specified frequency, searching for documents that should be refreshed.
about.metadataItem: Any document that has a @refresh metadata property whose time has passed at the time of the scan will be modified by removing this property.
about.triggerItem: This modification will trigger any processes related to the document, such as: re-indexing or taking part in an ongoing-task (e.g. Replication, ETL, Subscriptions, etc.), as defined by your configuration.
